name: French Admission Request (Demande d'admission)
description: French requests for admission to a care facility (demande d'admission en établissement de soins: SMR / SSR, HAD, USLD, EHPAD; ViaTrajectoire and in-house forms), made to anonymize a request before an AI checks it against the receiving unit's admission criteria. Hides every identifying field, also on two-column rows and with the label above the value: the patient's name (the civility stays), place of birth and the day and month of birth (the year stays so the age is known), home and care addresses, postal code and town, phones, e-mail, the trusted person and the relatives to contact (their relation stays: fils, fille, épouse), the GP, the specialist to contact, the responsible doctor, the cadre de santé and the social worker, the prescriber, the receiving unit, the current establishment and unit, the NIR (numéro de sécurité sociale) with its key, the caisse d'affiliation, the mutuelle and its member number, IPP, NDA, RPPS, FINESS and other IDs. The dossier number is hidden except its last 3 digits (2024-00157 shows 157). In the free text, names after M., Mme, Dr, Pr, née, épouse or a relation (sa fille Sophie) and street addresses are hidden too. Keeps what the criteria check needs: diagnoses and history, disease names (Parkinson, Alzheimer), treatments and doses, lab values, scores (GIR, MMSE, Barthel), age, sex, the dates of surgery, stay and admission, care needs and the discharge plan. Limits: on a scan, a value printed under its label is hidden only when it is a name after M., Mme or Dr, a phone, a NIR, a street or a postal code and town; on a scan the edge of the dossier box can cover part of the first kept digit, and the Markdown export replaces a dossier number written in one block with its label; handwriting is covered only when the scan text reads it; signatures are covered by the Signatures detector (BlurData 1.6.5 and later). Turn on Names in the side panel to also catch a name written alone in the text (it can hide disease names such as Parkinson too).

patterns.name: Patient
patterns.description: The patient's name after Patient, Patiente, Patient(e), Nom du patient, Identité or Bénéficiaire, with ':' or as a table row: LEFEBVRE Jeanne, DA SILVA Manuel, LE GALL Yann-Erwan, N'DIAYE Awa. The label and the civility (M., Mme, Madame) stay readable; the name ends before a comma, a date, née, a phone number or the next field.

patterns.name: Proche
patterns.description: Name of the trusted person and of the relatives to contact after Personne de confiance, Personne ressource / à prévenir, Personne à prévenir, Aidant, Tuteur, Curateur, Mandataire or Représentant légal. The relation in brackets (fils, fille, épouse) and the label stay readable; Non, Non désignée or Aucune stays as it is.

patterns.name: Médecin
patterns.description: Doctors' names after Médecin traitant, Médecin spécialiste à contacter, Médecin responsable, Médecin référent, Interne or Rédigé par, and after Dr, Docteur, Pr or Professeur anywhere in the text (Dr Anne ROUSSEAU, Pr Jean-Marc LEROY, Dr O. MARCHAND). The title stays readable. Turn it off to keep doctors' names visible.

patterns.name: Équipe
patterns.description: Names of the care team after Cadre, Cadre de santé, Assistant social, Assistante sociale, Infirmière référente, IDE, Psychologue, Secrétaire or Coordinatrice. The label and the civility stay readable.

patterns.name: Personne
patterns.description: Other people's names, in the form and in the free text: after M., Mme, Monsieur, Madame or Mlle (Mme PERRIN, 74 ans), after née, épouse or veuve (née MARTIN), after a relation (son mari Marc, sa fille Sophie) and after Nom, Prénom, Nom de naissance, Nom d'usage or Assuré. Disease names (Parkinson, Alzheimer, Gougerot-Sjögren) stay readable.

patterns.name: Prescripteur
patterns.description: The whole value after Prescripteur, Médecin prescripteur, Établissement or Service demandeur, Adressé par: doctor, hospital and ward (Dr Paul DURAND - CHU de Tours - Médecine interne). A phone number or e-mail after it gets its own box.

patterns.name: Établissement
patterns.description: The whole value after Unité receveuse, Référent actuel (Etablissement - Unité), Établissement, Service actuel, Unité d'accueil or Actuellement hospitalisé(e) à: CHRU de Tours - Hôpital Bretonneau - Gériatrie aiguë.

patterns.name: Dossier
patterns.description: The dossier number after Dossier, N° dossier, N° de dossier or Dossier n°, except its last 3 digits, which stay readable to find the request again: 2024-00157 shows only 157, 00012345678 shows 678. A number of 3 digits or less stays as it is.

patterns.name: Lieu naissance
patterns.description: Place of birth after Lieu de naissance, Ville de naissance, Commune, Pays or Département de naissance, and after né(e) à or né le … à (Saint-Avertin, Indre-et-Loire (37), Hanoï (Vietnam)).

patterns.name: Date naissance
patterns.description: Day and month of the date of birth after Né(e) le, Date de naissance, DDN or Naissance, or right before '(86 ans)': 04/07/1938 shows 1938, 3 février 1950 shows 1950. The year stays so the age is still known; turn on Année naissance to hide it too. Other dates (admission, surgery, stay) stay readable.

patterns.name: Année naissance
patterns.description: Year of birth, after the day and month hidden by Date naissance. Off by default so the age stays known.

patterns.name: Adresse
patterns.description: Street address: the value after Adresse, Adresse de domiciliation, Adresse des soins, Domicile or Lieu de résidence (12 rue des Lilas; EHPAD Les Glycines, 5 allée des Tilleuls; Lieu-dit La Ferrière), and a number with a street type anywhere (14 place Jean Jaurès, 8 bis avenue du Général de Gaulle). Idem, Identique or à domicile stays readable; the postal code and town after it get their own box.

patterns.name: CP Ville
patterns.description: Postal code and town: the value after Code postal - Ville, CP, Ville or Commune, and a 5-digit postal code followed by a town anywhere (37000 Tours, 37170 Chambray-lès-Tours, 33800 BORDEAUX, 75009 PARIS CEDEX 09). Doses and counts (25000 UI) stay readable.

patterns.name: Téléphone
patterns.description: Phone and fax numbers: French numbers in every form (02 47 12 34 56, 02.47.93.12.12, 0247590011, +33 6 55 44 33 22, +33 (0)6 45 67 89 01), foreign numbers written with +, and any number after Téléphone, Tél., Portable, Mobile or Fax. Numbers after a dossier, IPP or NIR label are left to those rules.

patterns.name: NIR
patterns.description: Numéro de sécurité sociale (NIR / INS): 13 digits and the 2-digit key, with or without spaces (2 38 07 37 261 045 72, 250029935212345, 1 45 06 29 232 018 / 66, Corsica 2A/2B), anywhere and after N° de sécurité sociale, N° SS, NIR, INS or Immatriculation.

patterns.name: Caisse
patterns.description: The health insurance fund after Caisse d'affiliation sécurité sociale, Caisse, Organisme d'assurance maladie or Centre payeur, and CPAM, MSA or CGSS followed by a place anywhere (CPAM d'Indre-et-Loire, CPAM 37, MSA Berry-Touraine). A plain Régime : Général stays readable.

patterns.name: Mutuelle
patterns.description: The complementary insurer: the value after Mutuelle complémentaire, Mutuelle, Complémentaire santé or AMC, the name after the 'Nom :' that follows them, and well-known mutuelles anywhere (Harmonie Mutuelle, MGEN, AG2R La Mondiale, Malakoff Humanis). Mutuelle : Oui or Non stays readable.

patterns.name: Identifiant
patterns.description: Other identifiers after their label: IPP, NDA, N° de séjour, N° de venue, N° de demande, N° adhérent, N° de contrat, N° AMC, RPPS, ADELI, FINESS (8812345, DA-2024-118734, MG 123 456 789). Dates after a label stay readable.
